design_tradeoffs: Shared ordinary query/text state is extracted as implementation rather than represented by effect callbacks.
Effect callbacks add explicit composition wiring while retaining current user-facing commands, return values, cancellation and stale-source checks.
Exact module aliases preserve legacy private patches; lower production consumers import canonical implementations.
Computed import fallback and reverse UI imports were rejected because they would hide dependency cycles.
limits: Focused suites overlap; do not add counts as unique tests. Durations are regression runtime, not controlled performance measurements.
Local owned PTY/process fixtures and fake scheduler paths do not qualify production Slurm, SSH, NFS, physical GPUs or other processor hardware.
